Sapphire at La Sienna brings premier new homes to the heart of Edinburg, recently named 2024 All-America City and one of the best places to live in South Texas. Choose from Contemporary, Farmhouse, Tuscan and Traditional elevations to create a home that’s truly your own. Sapphire at La Sienna features a clubhouse, pool, gym, paddleball court, half basketball court, and dog park. 

Conveniently located near highways 281 and I-69, Sapphire at La Sienna offers easy access to everything you need. Come see what makes Sapphire at La Sienna the perfect place to call home in Edinburg, TX!
